prose: RUN THE COMMAND; DO NOT READ A COUNT OFF ANY BOARD. bash intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/docs_defect_disposition_check.sh -- exit 0 means every member of the derived population carries a disposition and every `stated` claim was verified against the bytes of the page it names. Set AC0203_LIST_ALL=1 to list every undispositioned member rather than the first twelve; set CUT=<ref> to derive against a different cut. THIS ROW IS A CLAIM ABOUT THE REGISTER AT A MOMENT, so it goes red every time an issue is filed and that is its designed behaviour, not work being undone: the population is DERIVED at the cut on every run and never transcribed. It moved 213 -> 221 on 2026-09-05 alone. A number in a report is stale the moment a peer files; the command is not.
